text:
## Step 2: Enhanced Due Diligence Gate  
| Check | Evidence to Record | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Beneficial owners | Identity and ownership/control evidence for every owner above 25% | Onboarding Analyst |
| Source of funds | Credible evidence for an initial deposit above £10,000 | Onboarding Analyst |
| Enhanced screening | OFAC, EU, UN, HMT, PEP, sanctions, and adverse-media results | Financial Crime Analyst |
| Approval | Compliance approval and any documented exception decision | Head of Compliance / CRO |
name: Chunk 4/6

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Due Diligence Gate
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance checkpoint within account onboarding that verifies beneficial ownership, source of funds, and sanctions/PEP screening before account approval. The gate requires documented evidence collection and formal compliance sign-off.
context: Step 2: Enhanced Due Diligence Gate
Beneficial owners | Identity and ownership/control evidence for every owner above 25%
Enhanced screening | OFAC, EU, UN, HMT, PEP, sanctions, and adverse-media results
Approval | Compliance approval and any documented exception decision

raw_entities.name: Beneficial Owner Verification
raw_entities.description: Verification that identity and ownership/control evidence is collected and recorded for every beneficial owner holding above 25% stake in the account holder entity.
context: Beneficial owners | Identity and ownership/control evidence for every owner above 25%

raw_entities.name: Source of Funds Verification
raw_entities.description: Verification that credible evidence of legitimate source of funds is obtained and recorded for any initial deposit exceeding £10,000.
context: Source of funds | Credible evidence for an initial deposit above £10,000

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Sanctions and PEP Screening
raw_entities.description: Mandatory screening against multiple sanctions and PEP databases including OFAC, EU, UN, HMT lists, with adverse media checks, to identify politically exposed persons and sanctioned entities before account approval.
context: Enhanced screening | OFAC, EU, UN, HMT, PEP, sanctions, and adverse-media results

raw_entities.name: Compliance Approval Gate
raw_entities.description: Final formal approval by Compliance leadership (Head of Compliance or CRO) to proceed with account opening, including documented exception decisions where applicable.
context: Approval | Compliance approval and any documented exception decision

raw_entities.name: Onboarding Analyst
raw_entities.description: Operations role responsible for collecting and recording beneficial owner identity evidence and source of funds documentation during the Enhanced Due Diligence Gate.
context: Beneficial owners | Identity and ownership/control evidence for every owner above 25% | Onboarding Analyst
Source of funds | Credible evidence for an initial deposit above £10,000 | Onboarding Analyst

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Analyst
raw_entities.description: Specialist role responsible for executing enhanced screening checks against OFAC, EU, UN, HMT, PEP, and adverse media databases during the Enhanced Due Diligence Gate.
context: Enhanced screening | OFAC, EU, UN, HMT, PEP, sanctions, and adverse-media results | Financial Crime Analyst

raw_entities.name: Head of Compliance / CRO
raw_entities.description: Senior compliance authority responsible for final approval of account opening following Enhanced Due Diligence Gate completion, with authority to document and approve exceptions.
context: Approval | Compliance approval and any documented exception decision | Head of Compliance / CRO

raw_entities.name: OFAC Screening
raw_entities.description: Screening against the Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctions list as part of enhanced due diligence during account onboarding.
context: Enhanced screening | OFAC, EU, UN, HMT, PEP, sanctions, and adverse-media results

raw_entities.name: PEP Screening
raw_entities.description: Screening to identify politically exposed persons as part of enhanced due diligence during account onboarding.
context: Enhanced screening | OFAC, EU, UN, HMT, PEP, sanctions, and adverse-media results

raw_entities.name: Adverse Media Check
raw_entities.description: Screening for adverse media coverage as part of enhanced due diligence during account onboarding.
context: Enhanced screening | OFAC, EU, UN, HMT, PEP, sanctions, and adverse-media results
